title: wiretap: Unify IDB generation into a common function
description:
We have two different places for "generate an IDB given an
encapsulation, timestamp precision, and snap length", one used
by wtap dumper and one used when reading files.

Have a common static function, filled in with the appropriate pars
of the wtap struct or wtap_dump_params struct.
